target.title: fix(googlechat): bound webhook cert fetch during token verification
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Google Chat webhook authentication could hang indefinitely when
Google's signing-certificate endpoint accepts a connection but never completes the
HTTP response. This path runs on cold start and again every 10 minutes when the cert
cache expires, so a stalled `googleapis.com` request blocks all incoming Google Chat
message verification until the gateway process is restarted.

Outbound Google Chat API timeouts were already addressed in #102227; this PR closes
the remaining unbounded fetch in the inbound auth path.

## Why This Change Was Made

`fetchChatCerts()` in `extensions/googlechat/src/auth.ts` calls `fetchWithSsrFGuard`
without a deadline. The fix adds a 30-second `timeoutMs` via a local
`GOOGLECHAT_AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS` constant, matching the deadline already used for outbound
Chat API calls and sibling channel plugins.

## User Impact

**Before:** A stalled cert endpoint leaves webhook auth pending forever; incoming Google
Chat messages fail silently with no timeout error and no lane release.

**After:** Cert fetch aborts after 30 seconds with a concrete error; verification returns
`{ ok: false, reason: ... }` and the gateway can continue processing other traffic.

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/googlechat-api-request-timeout`  
Base: `upstream/main`  
Node: v22.22.0 — macOS Darwin 24.3.0 arm64

### Regression tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/googlechat/src/auth.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ Google Chat cert-fetch timeout > passes timeoutMs to fetchWithSsrFGuard when fetching certs 3ms
 ✓ Google Chat cert-fetch timeout > surfaces an abort error when the cert endpoint stalls 1ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
   Duration  4.22s
```

Test 1 asserts `fetchWithSsrFGuard` receives a positive numeric `timeoutMs` on a real
`verifyGoogleChatRequest` call with `audienceType: "project-number"` and an empty cert
cache.

Test 2 asserts that when `fetchWithSsrFGuard` rejects with an `AbortError`, the caller
receives `{ ok: false, reason: /aborted/i }` rather than hanging.

### Diff summary

```
extensions/googlechat/src/auth.ts      |  5 +++++ (constant + timeoutMs field)
extensions/googlechat/src/auth.test.ts | 70 ++++++  (new file — 2 regression cases)
```

What was not tested: a live `googleapis.com` stall scenario with a real Google Workspace
account. Crabbox/Testbox remote CI was not run at submission time.
